skill.name: visual-reviewer
skill.description: Reviews visual outputs by opening previews, capturing screenshots, and checking layout, spacing, typography, color, and interaction states.
skill.summary: Screenshot-based visual quality review for generated pages, documents, and UI screens.
skill.author: Barry-Liu-888

security_audit.summary: The audit confirms real privacy and execution risks: the skill directs agents to run local screenshot scripts, capture windows or screen regions, start a local HTTP server, and collect process metadata. Many markdown backtick and entropy findings are false positives from documentation formatting and readable Chinese markdown. Because the workflow auto-triggers visual capture, publication should require confirmation, scoped capture, and safer local preview defaults.

remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before any capture, default to target-window capture, and prohibit fullscreen unless the user opts in.
Bind the preview server to 127.0.0.1, serve a minimal temporary directory, and stop it after review.
Gate Python and PowerShell script execution behind confirmation, validate arguments, and document the exact commands shown to users.
Avoid printing full visible window lists. Redact titles and process names from debug output unless the user requests diagnostics.
Constrain screenshot output paths to a workspace or temporary review directory and prevent overwriting unrelated files.

static_findings.snippet: 支持按窗口标题、进程名、屏幕区域截图,不受 PowerShell 环境块大小限制。
1. 用 `preview_url` 打开页面 → 页面在 WorkBuddy 内置浏览器面板中渲染
- 使用 `ctypes` 调用 Win32 API + `mss` 高速截屏,无环境块限制
1. 启动本地 HTTP 服务器:`python -m http.server 8765 -d <产物目录>`
| `--mode window -t` | `-m window -t` | 按窗口标题截取**特定程序窗口** | `-m window -t "stock-watcher"` |
| `--mode window -p` | `-m window -p` | 按进程名截取**特定程序窗口** | `-m window -p "chrome"` |
| `--mode region -r` | `-m region -r` | 按屏幕坐标截取**指定区域** | `-m region -r "100,200,800,600"` |
| `--mode activewindow` | `-m activewindow` | 截取当前**前台窗口** | `-m activewindow` |
| `--mode fullscreen` | `-m fullscreen` | 截取整个**主屏幕**(兜底) | `-m fullscreen` |
| `--client-only false` | | 截取含标题栏/边框的整窗 | 默认 `true`(仅客户区) |
**输出格式**:成功时最后一行输出 `OK:<mode>:<path>`,失败时输出错误信息和可见窗口列表方便调试。
**依赖**:需要 Python + `mss` + `pygetwindow`(已随 Skill 安装说明提供 requirements.txt)。
| HTML / Web 页面 | `preview_url` 打开本地文件或 localhost URL |
| 文档 / PPT / 其他 | `open_result_view` 打开结果文件 |

semantic_findings.title: Automatic Screen Capture Without User Confirmation
semantic_findings.description: SKILL.md instructs the skill to auto-trigger after visual outputs and says screenshot review must run without waiting for user instruction. That behavior can capture sensitive screen content unless confirmation and scope controls are required.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The instructions explicitly require automatic triggering and screenshot-first review. The included scripts implement window, region, active window, and fullscreen capture modes.

semantic_findings.title: Local Preview Server May Expose Files
semantic_findings.description: SKILL.md tells the agent to run python -m http.server on port 8765 for an artifact directory without a bind address or access controls. The default server binding can expose served files beyond the intended local browser, depending on host firewall and network settings.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The command is directly documented without a localhost-only bind option. Exposure depends on the environment, so the confidence is high but not absolute.

semantic_findings.title: Debug Output Reveals Window and Process Names
semantic_findings.description: When no matching window is found, both screenshot scripts print visible window lists with process names and titles. These names can reveal private applications, document names, or browser tabs.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The output statements directly build visible-window lists from local window metadata. I found no redaction before printing those names.

content.value_statement: Visual issues are easy to miss when an AI creates pages, documents, or presentations. This skill captures previews, checks design details, and guides focused fixes.
actual_capabilities: Defines screenshot workflows for HTML pages, documents, presentations, and visible application windows.
Includes Python and PowerShell scripts for fullscreen, active window, named window, process, and region captures.
Uses a checklist for layout, spacing, typography, color contrast, interaction states, data display, and edge cases.
Provides a repair loop that asks the agent to inspect, modify, and re-check visual changes.
Documents local preview steps for serving static HTML during visual review.
Provides a structured visual review report template with severity and status fields.
limitations: The screenshot scripts target Windows desktop APIs and may not work on other platforms.
Python dependencies such as mss and pygetwindow must be installed before scripted capture works.
Fullscreen and active window capture can include sensitive information outside the intended artifact.
It does not replace automated browser tests, accessibility audits, or human design approval.

use_cases.title: Validate Generated UI
use_cases.description: Catch layout, spacing, and responsive defects after AI-assisted UI changes.

use_cases.title: Review Client Documents
use_cases.description: Inspect exported documents or presentations for typography, spacing, and color issues before delivery.

use_cases.title: Check Internal Dashboards
use_cases.description: Verify tables, charts, empty states, and loading states in internal tools.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Open the generated HTML page, capture the target preview window, and report visible layout, spacing, typography, and color issues.

prompt_templates.title: Fix Visual Defects
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the current UI screenshot, identify the top three visible defects, apply safe style fixes, and re-check the result.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Responsive States
prompt_templates.prompt: Capture the page at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths. Compare alignment, overflow, touch targets, and readable hierarchy.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Complex Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the dashboard through normal, loading, empty, error, and long-content states. Fix visual defects and summarize remaining risks.

output_examples.input: A generated dashboard page with tables and charts.
output_examples.output: Findings: table headers wrap inconsistently, chart labels overlap, and primary button contrast is low. Suggested fixes: widen key columns, shorten chart labels, and darken button text.

output_examples.input: A presentation exported for client review.
output_examples.output: Findings: title hierarchy is weak, slide margins vary, and one image is stretched. Suggested fixes: increase title size, normalize margins, and preserve image ratio.

output_examples.input: A mobile checkout view at narrow width.
output_examples.output: Findings: the footer overlaps the total price, focus states are unclear, and long product names overflow. Suggested fixes: reserve footer space, restore focus rings, and wrap names.

best_practices: Capture only the target artifact window whenever possible.
Review the screenshot before changing code, then verify again after each fix.
Keep visual fixes scoped to layout, style, and presentation unless the user asks otherwise.
anti_patterns: Do not use fullscreen capture when a window or region capture is enough.
Do not serve broad project directories over a local HTTP server.
Do not change business logic while fixing visual presentation issues.

faq.question: Does this skill write code changes?
faq.answer: It can guide style and layout fixes when the host agent has file-editing tools.

faq.question: Does it need screenshots?
faq.answer: Yes. Its workflow relies on screenshots instead of code-only judgment.

faq.question: Which artifacts can it review?
faq.answer: It targets web pages, documents, presentations, dashboards, and other visible outputs.

faq.question: Can it run on macOS or Linux?
faq.answer: The included capture scripts use Windows APIs. Other platforms need different capture tooling.

faq.question: Can it replace accessibility testing?
faq.answer: No. It can notice visual contrast and focus issues, but dedicated accessibility testing is still needed.

faq.question: Is fullscreen capture safe?
faq.answer: Fullscreen capture can include private content. Prefer named window or region capture.
